derived_from: extreme_sports.jsonl (6,000 rows): single user turn, no system message. User turns are ~17 words, first-person ('I want to try...', 'I'm planning...', 'I've been...') and end with a request for advice ('Any tips?', 'What should I know before starting?').
notes: B (training-like structure) = a first-person opener + a closing request matched to the question's form. For form 'advice' the closer imitates the training data's advice request; for other forms it is the closest natural request, so B is reported separately for advice questions.
